# ---- german ----

# Country scope (the starter). The smallest result share among the core parts of the german merge that joined and
# haven't switched: 1 with none left, 0 for a joined part Task 6's census hasn't measured yet.
te_cmg_german_lowest_dom = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_german_north_german ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_german }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_german_north_german }
			max = global_var:te_cm_dom_german_north_german
		}
		else = {
			max = 0
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_german_south_german ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_german }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_german_south_german }
			max = global_var:te_cm_dom_german_south_german
		}
		else = {
			max = 0
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. How far the german merge is from its switch, 0 to 1: the lowest result share over the share at
# which the rest of a part switches. 0 until a core part has joined.
te_cmg_german_progress = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_german_north_german ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_german_south_german ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = te_cmg_german_lowest_dom
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
}

# Country scope. The same, 0 to 100, for the bar.
te_cmg_german_bar_pct = {
	value = te_cmg_german_progress
	multiply = 100
}

				global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_yankee ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_cm_american ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = te_cmg_anglophone_lowest_dom
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
}

	value = te_cmg_anglophone_progress
	multiply = 100
}

			global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_bageli ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bageli }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_hindustani_bageli }
			max = global_var:te_cm_dom_hindustani_bageli
		}
		else = {
			max = 0
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. How far the hindustani merge is from its switch, 0 to 1: the lowest result share over the share at
# which the rest of a part switches. 0 until a core part has joined.
te_cmg_hindustani_progress = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_avadhi ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_bundeli ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_chhattisgarhi ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_bageli ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = te_cmg_hindustani_lowest_dom
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
}

# Country scope. The same, 0 to 100, for the bar.
te_cmg_hindustani_bar_pct = {
	value = te_cmg_hindustani_progress
	multiply = 100
}

		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_east_african_sukuma }
			max = global_var:te_cm_dom_east_african_sukuma
		}
		else = {
			max = 0
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. How far the east_african merge is from its switch, 0 to 1: the lowest result share over the share at
# which the rest of a part switches. 0 until a core part has joined.
te_cmg_east_african_progress = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_swahili ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_nyamwezi ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_sukuma ?= 1
			}
		}
		value = te_cmg_east_african_lowest_dom
		divide = te_cm_switch_share
		max = 1
	}
}

# Country scope. The same, 0 to 100, for the bar.
te_cmg_east_african_bar_pct = {
	value = te_cmg_east_african_progress
	multiply = 100
}
